summary.tagline: A carboniferous limestone circular trail featuring ancient woodland and 14-meter drops.
summary.seo_title: Ingleton Waterfalls Trail Circular Walking Guide

travel.headline: Pay on Arrival at the Ticket Office
travel.reservation: There is no need to pre-book; payments are made by card only at the ticket office on the day of your visit. Access is subject to weather conditions, so contact the ticket office directly to confirm if the trail is open during extreme weather events. Ticket holders have access to limited free parking at the Broadwood car park.

days.title: The clockwise waterfalls walk
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM at the trail ticket office; check current entry hours

stops.name: Swilla Glen
stops.detail: Enter a deep carboniferous limestone glen filled with oak and birch woodland where mosses and ferns thrive.

stops.name: Pecca Falls
stops.detail: Cross Manor Bridge to witness these falls within the moist environment of the limestone gorge.

stops.name: Hollybush Spout
stops.detail: Ascend a series of steep steps to reach open moorland where the river transitions to a shallow valley.

stops.name: Thornton Force
stops.detail: Observe the trail's most famous geological feature, where water falls 14 metres over a limestone cliff.

stops.name: Beezley Falls
stops.detail: Continue into oak woodland along the River Doe to view Beezley Falls on the marked trail.

stops.name: Snow Falls
stops.detail: Look back after passing Baxenghyll Gorge to catch a view of this waterfall before finishing the loop.

days.driving: Walking circuit, not a driving route; allow two and a half to four hours, depending on pace.
days.note: Follow the one-way clockwise trail; check extreme-weather closures and download the official guide before departure.

intel.title: Broadwood Car Park
intel.text: Limited free parking is available for ticket holders at the start of the trail. The car park also hosts a refreshment kiosk and toilet facilities.

intel.title: Offline Navigation Required
intel.text: Mobile data is not available around the trail area. Visitors should download the self-guided geology and ecology guide before arrival.

intel.title: Local Supply Gap
intel.text: The evidence does not specify fuel station locations in Ingleton. Travelers should verify fuel levels before entering the Dales region.

intel.title: Completion Estimates
intel.text: The 4.5-mile circular route typically takes between 2.5 and 4 hours. Pace varies significantly based on fitness and stops for photography.

intel.title: Weather Closures
intel.text: The trail closes during extreme weather for safety reasons. It is recommended to ring the ticket office for the latest status if rain is heavy.

plan.arrival: Upon arrival in Ingleton, proceed to the ticket office to pay by card. The trail begins with a woodland walk through the river glen.
plan.vehicle: Check actual rental and local road restrictions before travel; confirm parking suitability for larger vehicles with the operator.
plan.goldenHour: Thornton Force is a possible photography stop during permitted opening hours; choose lighting to suit the season and never extend the visit beyond last entry or closure.

editorial_review: One clockwise half-day circuit, exact operator evidence; no paid replay.
